material_definitions: The mixed phosphates A(I) B(IV)2 (PO4)3 (A = Li, Na, K; B = Ge, Ti, Hf, Zr) form a three-dimensional network with the space group R-3C composed of BO6 octahedra and PO4 tetrahedra.
Solid electrolytes based on LiTi2(PO4)3 were prepared with partial substitution of Ti4+ by various trivalent (Al, Cr, Ga, Fe, Sc, In, Lu, Y, La) or tetravalent (Ge, Zr) ions.
The Li1+xTi2SixP3-xO12 system was synthesized by replacing P5+ with Si4+ to enhance sintering and lithium ion conductivity.
Sintering was typically conducted at temperatures between 1173 K and 1473 K for 2 hours to achieve high pellet density.
Substitution of smaller or similarly sized trivalent ions for Ti4+ generally results in a rhombohedral single-phase structure and significantly improved ionic conductivity.
